Title: Antimalarial activity for sexual stage and asexual blood stage (ABS)
Description: Separates compounds that kill transmissible Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes from those active on asexual blood-stage parasites, a distinction that matters because gametocytocidal chemistry blocks onward transmission while blood-stage activity treats the patient. Van Heerden and colleagues pooled library screens covering 126,374 asexual and 93,941 sexual-stage compounds, rebalanced them by clustering and trained circular-fingerprint models, a support vector classifier and a random forest. Barely 3% of actives hit both stages.
Interpretation: Probabilities of activity against the sexual and asexual stages of Plasmodium falciparum.
